offering_description.value: Greif manufactures industrial containers for chemical, food, agricultural and other manufacturers. It also makes recycled paperboard and paper tubes and cores for converters and industrial customers. Its container services include collecting, reconditioning and recycling used packaging.

primary_products.value: Steel, plastic and fiber drums; intermediate bulk containers; plastic jerrycans; uncoated recycled paperboard; paper tubes and cores

primary_services.value: Used container collection; container reconditioning; packaging recycling

customer_segment.value: B2B: Chemical producers, food and beverage processors, agricultural suppliers, pharmaceutical manufacturers and paper converters

end_markets.value: Chemicals; food and beverage; agriculture; pharmaceuticals; paper converting

revenue_model.value: product sales: Industrial containers, recycled paperboard, and paper tubes and cores; service fees: Used container collection, reconditioning and recycling

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Converts steel, plastics and recovered fiber into packaging and paper products for manufacturers and converters; service provider: Collects used containers from industrial customers and supplies reconditioned containers for reuse

geography_served.value: global: North America, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Industrial containers, recycled paperboard, paper tubes and cores, and container reconditioning

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving industrial manufacturers and paper converters; distributors / dealers: Industrial packaging distributors that stock drums and other containers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Hazardous-material packaging follows transport standards, and manufacturing and reconditioning facilities are subject to environmental and workplace safety rules.

notes: The exact current scope of the paper packaging portfolio is uncertain following recent divestitures.
